ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite monitoring tool specifically tracking urban sprawl, illegal deforestation, and water body degradation around Pune's industrial and protected zones.
ideas.title: EcoWatch Pune: Satellite Land Cover and Deforestation Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact winning pattern of GeoNex-ATLAS by applying satellite data monitoring to real environmental SDG challenges, which deeply appeals to ACM academic judges focused on sustainability.

ideas.pitch: A machine learning platform predicting pollution spikes and dissolved oxygen depletion in local rivers 48 hours in advance using historical sensor data and weather inputs.
ideas.title: AquaSense Pune: Mula-Mutha River Water Quality Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the iForeSea-AquaSense win by addressing a local, urgent environmental metric (river health) with clear, actionable predictive models.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision garbage classification system optimized for local municipal waste streams, paired with an Arduino prototype simulation to assist dry and wet waste routing.
ideas.title: WasteSort AI: Smart Municipal Segregation Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly builds on the TechnoMorph Hackathon runner-up project, providing a physical and practical AI application that targets urban solid waste management under SDG 11.

ideas.pitch: A machine learning pipeline that forecasts solar and wind energy output using local meteorological data to optimize microgrid storage efficiency.
ideas.title: GridPulse: Renewable Energy Generation Forecasting for Local Microgrids
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the winning architecture of the Energy A.I. Hackathon 2025 by delivering a production-ready forecasting backend that supports clean energy transitions.

ideas.pitch: An AI risk-assessment platform calculating dryness indices and wildfire probability for rural agricultural belts surrounding Maharashtra using satellite indices and weather feeds.
ideas.title: AgroShield AI: Hyper-Local Wildfire and Crop Risk Assessment
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the Sacramento State AI Hackathon winning formula to regional agricultural vulnerabilities, providing measurable risk mitigation scores for farmers.
